sources.title: Introducing Claude
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. March 14, 2023 launch names Claude and Claude Instant and describes chat/API access, conversation, text processing, summarization, writing, Q&A and coding. It links the assistant to Anthropic's helpful/honest/harmless research, but names no parameter count or specific 52B research model as its base.

sources.title: Introducing 100K context windows
sources.evidence: May 11, 2023 announcement explicitly says Claude's context expanded from 9K to 100K tokens. Establishes the earlier nominal 9K context and the later upgrade; it does not make the March release a 100K model.

sources.title: Model Card and Evaluations for Claude Models
sources.evidence: Fresh PDF retrieved October 27, 2026 from Anthropic's canonical CDN URL ending /5c49cc247484cecf107c699baf29250302e5da70/ModelCardClaudev2_with_appendix_v1.pdf; independently inspected cached text. The November 21, 2023 card says previous Claude models use a transformer. Figure 6 has a parameter-scaled plot for prior research preference/language models beside a separate Claude Instant 1.1/1.3/2 score bar chart: the parameter axis does not assign sizes to Claude. Section 4.3 compares evaluation scores, without total or activated-parameter columns. No original-Claude nominal count or sized-base identity is given.

sources.title: Model deprecations
sources.evidence: The September 4, 2024 history groups Claude 1 models and separately lists claude-1.0, claude-1.1, claude-1.2 and claude-1.3, all retired November 6, 2024. Confirms version distinctions and historical endpoint retirement.

sources.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. December 2022 Constitutional AI paper explicitly reports 52B experimental SL-CAI, pretrained, RLHF and RL-CAI models (Figures 2 and 8, sections 3.3 and 4), as well as 52B preference models. Its full text does not name Claude. These are real nominal research-model sizes, but no explicit named-model relationship identifies the March 2023 commercial Claude as one of them.

sources.title: Third-party testing in AI policy
sources.evidence: Anthropic characterizes itself as primarily developing proprietary systems. This is company-level context, not an explicit license or weight-release statement for the original Claude checkpoint.

sources.title: Anthropic's Responsible Scaling Policy, Version 1.0
sources.evidence: September 19, 2023 policy treats model weights as core intellectual property and describes restricted staff access under ASL-2 containment; explicitly classifies Claude 2 as ASL-2. It does not explicitly classify the original Claude 1 checkpoint or state its license, so it is contextual rather than decisive variant-specific evidence.

sources.title: Claude can now use tools
sources.evidence: May 30, 2024 announcement documents native tool use for the Claude 3 family. It does not establish a native tool-calling specification for original Claude 1.

sources.title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Claude Code
sources.evidence: February 24, 2025 announcement introduces a hybrid reasoning model with an explicit extended-thinking mode. This later capability is not evidence of such a mode in Claude 1.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. This is first-party evidence about weight availability independent of the existence of a hosted API; the paper's benchmark models are newer Claude versions.

sources.title: Model Pricing: Claude-v1 and Claude Instant
sources.evidence: Opened October 27, 2026 via the original launch link labeled two versions of Claude. One-page sheet lists model descriptions, 9,000-token context, pricing and dedicated capacity; it gives no total or active parameter count.

sources.title: Training a Helpful and Harmless Assistant with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 after following HELM's 52B citation. April 2022 paper section 2.3 describes 52B context-distilled and RLHF research models and a 52B preference model; section 4.2 scans seven sizes from 13M to 52B. Full text contains no Claude name and supplies no identity statement connecting these research models to commercial Claude 1.

sources.title: HELM model documentation, v0.5.7
sources.evidence: Secondary lead only, opened October 27, 2026. Labels Claude v1.3 a 52B model and links directly to the April 2022 RLHF paper (s12). That cited primary paper does not identify Claude. The assertion also targets later v1.3, not the original March release, so it does not verify this record's count.

sources.title: Anthropic Business Breakdown and Founding Story
sources.evidence: Secondary lead only, opened October 27, 2026. Attributes 430 million parameters to Claude 1 and links that number to a Product Hunt article (s15), not an Anthropic specification. No primary count or named-base evidence supports the claim in that citation chain.

sources.title: Claude 2: What it is and how to use Claude AI
sources.evidence: Secondary lead only, opened October 27, 2026. The July 17, 2023 article states 860 million versus 430 million parameters for Claude 2 versus original Claude, without a supporting Anthropic parameter disclosure. The same sentence incorrectly dates Claude 2 to July 2022. This does not establish a nominal specification.

sources.title: Scaling Monosemanticity: Extracting Interpretable Features from Claude 3 Sonnet
sources.evidence: Fresh full HTML retrieved and text inspected October 27, 2026 after web extraction exceeded its size limit. The May 2024 study explicitly identifies production Claude 3 Sonnet, and reports sparse-autoencoder feature and training quantities. It provides no original-Claude total or active count, nor a named size-preserving relationship to the original model; SAE feature counts are not language-model parameter counts.

sources.title: The Claude 3 Model Family: Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, with addenda
sources.evidence: Fresh PDF retrieved October 27, 2026; independently inspected cached text, including comparison sections and parameter references. Figure 8 names a helpful-only model based on Claude 1.3 but gives no size. Section 5.8 describes relative parameter scaling from Haiku to Opus without numerical counts. No total or activated-parameter comparison establishes a size for original Claude 1.

sources.title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh PDF retrieved October 27, 2026; independently inspected cached text for model details, comparisons and parameter references. The card explains later Claude training and thinking modes, but gives no original-Claude total or activated-parameter specification or explicit sized-base relationship.

name.note: Retrospective generation label for the original assistant launched as Claude; scope is the March 2023 release, not all subsequent 1.x upgrades.

developer.note: Anthropic's own launch identifies the developer.

family.note: Normalized Claude family name; official history distinguishes numbered Claude 1 versions.

release_date.note: Explicit public launch date. Earlier closed-alpha partner access is not this release date.

open_weights.note: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. Exact-model sources document the commercial hosted offering; this classification uses the general distribution policy without transferring technical specifications from newer models.

license.note: Descriptive proprietary classification, supported by non-distribution of Claude weights and commercial hosted access; not a named open-weight redistribution license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh launch, pricing, original research, later-card and interpretability review found no nominal count or explicit sized-base identity for original Claude. The published 52B CAI/RLHF research counts are valid for those experiments; neither first-party text nor the secondary HELM citation identifies the March commercial model with them. The 430M secondary claim has no supporting primary disclosure.

active_parameters_b.note: Rechecked separately: no inspected first-party comparison table or model description reports activated parameters for original Claude. Figure 6 of the later Claude 2 card assigns a parameter axis only to prior research models, not to its adjacent Claude score bars. Dense structure and equality of active and total parameters cannot be inferred.

architecture.note: The later card explicitly includes previous Claude models in its transformer description. Dense versus MoE and finer architecture are not disclosed.

context_window.note: Nominal 9K tokens for the original pre-May release, from the explicit 9K-to-100K upgrade statement. Do not substitute 100K or infer 8192/9216 from the rounded marketing figure.

modalities.note: Original launch describes conversation and text processing; long-context announcement demonstrates text prompts and textual answers.

reasoning.note: General problem-solving or prompted chain of thought does not establish the catalog's dedicated reasoning capability. No original-release reasoning-mode specification was verified.

tool_call.note: Launch search/coding use cases and third-party integrations do not prove native function calling. The inspected official tool-use announcement covers Claude 3, not Claude 1.

description.value: Original Claude text assistant released by Anthropic in March 2023, before the later 100K-context upgrade.
description.note: Replaces the generic historical label with the identity and release scope supported by primary announcements.

patch.description: Original Claude text assistant released by Anthropic in March 2023, before the later 100K-context upgrade.
patch.notes: This record denotes the original March 14, 2023 Claude release, not Claude 1.3 or its 100K-context upgrade. The earlier context is documented as a nominal 9K tokens. A later Anthropic model card identifies previous Claude models as transformers; original-Claude total/active parameters and dense versus MoE structure remain undisclosed. Published 52B research models are not explicitly identified as this commercial model. Anthropic states that Claude weights are not publicly released; proprietary is a descriptive classification. Claude 1.x API models were retired November 6, 2024.

summary: October 27 parameter-only re-audit retained null/undisclosed total and active counts after reopening original launch/pricing and 2022 research, inspecting fresh later Claude cards and interpretability work, and running targeted searches for nominal/activated disclosures. Resolved the 52B lead to research models lacking an explicit commercial-Claude identity; resolved the 430M lead to unsupported secondary reporting. Figure 6 in the Claude 2 card does not assign research-model parameter positions to Claude. Other audited fields are preserved.
